name: Give Me a Sun
source:
After years of having to leave her native city, Celeste returns to find out what happened to her missing older brother.

Reconnecting with her past and forging a future for her loved ones is her goal.

[From [url=https://namco15.itch.io/give-me-a-sun]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
不得不离开家乡多年后，塞莱斯特回来寻找失踪的哥哥的下落。

与她的过去重新建立联系并为她所爱的人创造未来是她的目标。

[来自[url=https://namco15.itch.io/give-me-a-sun]Itch.io[/url]]
